bestBets.overview: Modest race. RUSKANA brings some consistent NSW form that looks very strong for a race like this. There's subsequent winning form from well behind him last time. The only unknown for him is the Moe heavy 10. If he doesn't win, it's  raffle. CLYDEBANK ROBBER goes around in these races every one or two weeks and it's surprising he hasn't raced on heavy ground for almost 3 years. Maybe it helps him. The tempo was far too slow for him last time. KING TAGALOA has a chance on his return and no chance on his latest. The return was on a H9 and last start a S5 so he gets another go on this ground. JONQUIL has been ok in her two runs back . She was luckless for her only start in this distance range. LOMENIE has her tricks at the start. Last time she began with them and rode a solid speed. Maybe she's better if she flops out of the gates and comes from well back. Sale two back was ok when she missed it 5L. ZAREENEE is bred to stay. Will concede a firmer surface probably helped her last time but so did the rise in trip. She's too lightly raced to condemn on one heavy fail.

raceTips.comment:
Ruskana looks brilliantly placed to get a maiden victory, the heavy ground aside. He was good putting a big gap on third in a much stronger race last start and has jumped out between runs since. If he handles the ground he should win, the knock is taking odds on about a horse that's never seen a track anywhere near as heavy previously. 
Jonquil was doing her best work late last start and is suited rising in distance third up. If the favourite flounders in the conditions she might be the one picking up the pieces.

raceTips.comment:

Koko comes through a high-rating race last start and has the advantage of race fitness and race experience.

bestBets.overview: Another tough one with the potential for a double figure odds winner.  With D Stackhouse aboard and finally a lowish draw, DAZZLING SECRET will run very well. Last start he had a very tough run in transit over 1200m and no surprise he finished last. The Price/Kent trained Semelle Rouge had a similar forgetful run in the same race and she came back to the 1000m and won a BM62. DAZZLING SECRET won well prior. Very wary of improvement from PACIFIC GLAMOUR. 10 months ago, she'd start odds on and win this. Last start which was forgivable was her first run for this young stable who are producing winners. Jett Stanley gets back aboard WIND DREAMER after she had a forget run last time. This wetter track suits. ROCKCLIFF is drawn for a good run in transit. He's come back well. LAKE GILLEAR, NASRAAWY and BOLD SUITOR have obvious claims away from some of these rougher ones.

raceTips.comment:
Nasraawy is suited dropping in class. His last win came at this track and distance in this class three starts ago when he dominated the race from the front. That should be the plan again here however the presence of Bold Suitor and Lake Gillear who'll also want to lead are the complicating factors.
Bold Suitor tackles the weakest race he's contested since winning his maiden. 
Lake Gillear gets blinkers first time and has plenty of speed.
Per Ivy could be the blowout if she can find anything like her best form. She has a terrific record at the track and distance and should now be fit.
